notes: v556 — THE PAULA–NINÓ EDGE TAKES THE MAIN TABLE. The Range column's seat now belongs to 💰 PN Edge: for every share whose strongest PROVEN line fired today, you see the money — ‘+$2.42/$100’ in its gauge colour with the mini bar on the fixed $0–$3.50 scale. Hover it and the tooltip names the exact lines (combos included), the tier, and the plain meaning. Shares with nothing proven firing show an honest ‘—’ — hover it and the app tells you that's normal. TAP THE COLUMN HEADER (or pick 💰 PN Edge in Sort by) to rank the entire market by proven money — probably the most useful single click in the app. Range didn't die: it moved into the same cell's hover, and the range picker is retired. The column reads the very same grades as the radar and 🎯 Best Evidence, so all three always agree. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
